how: Claude agent reading of the stored title + abstract, blind to the curated graph, with EXTRACT_INSTRUCTIONS and CLAIM_SCHEMA

claims.quote: MPS II symptoms are caused by mutations in the lysosomal iduronate-2-sulfatase (IDS) gene.
The mutations cause a loss of enzymatic performance and result in the accumulation of glycosaminoglycans (GAGs), heparan sulfate and dermatan sulfate, which are no longer degradable.
